## Summary

Describe the requested change.

## User or Role

Which role needs this: firm administrator, accountant, senior reviewer, client/document submitter, auditor/read-only user, or another role?

## Problem

What problem does this solve?

## Proposed Outcome

What should the user be able to do?

## Accounting-Control Considerations

Does the feature affect approvals, corrections, journal balance, tax treatment, audit history, or segregation of duties?

## Security and Privacy Considerations

Does the feature affect authentication, authorisation, tenant isolation, personal data, financial data, integrations, or logs?

## Validation Needed

What practitioner, tax, legal, privacy, or technical validation is needed?

## Non-Goals

What should this feature explicitly not do?
